# XHelpers Pro 1.0.10 (19)
- Import and update public YouTube playlists without signing in to Google or supplying developer credentials. Public details use the publisher's service after a separate privacy disclosure. - YouTube account connection, account playlists and Liked Videos are not available in this version. Existing account imports and saved access remain on this Mac, but account items cannot be refreshed or played. You can remove saved access locally and manage Google's authorization in Google Account permissions. - Public imports show short service cooldowns and can be cancelled. Saved playlist structure survives temporary service failures and the account feature's unavailability; cached API information still expires.
YouTube's visible player, video availability and playback restrictions still apply. Local audio/video and Apple Music keep their existing behavior.
